// JSX edge cases, kept apart from the readable corpus: a brace that opens // while the lexer is in :interpol rather than in an expression start, and a // nested brace that goes through :interpol_inner. Both are lexed by the // reference gem, so the golden is the gem's answer for them too. const odd = <div>{foo {bar}}</div>; // A fragment, a dotted component name, a self-closing tag with a quoted // attribute, and raw HTML text between the tags. const frag = ( <> <Ns.Deep.Component name='single' other="double" flag /> plain &amp; text <b>bold</b> {/* a comment inside an interpolation */} </> );
